title: Blobbs a friend in your Browser
author: Candid_Bullfrog_146
selftext:
**Blobbs** is a child-friendly artificial life simulation.

Together with your Blobb you can paint little pictures, compose music and practice English or German. Take care of your Blobb's needs and spend time together: play rock-paper-scissors, treat it to a hot cocoa when it feels sad, or a tasty burger when its energy runs low.

Your Blobb tells you about its day in its personal diary, shows you what it has painted and, if you let it, plays you music it composed itself from time to time. It also explores its world and goes on dungeon adventures to collect loot.

You can personalize your Blobb with different clothes, hairstyles and more.

Blobbs is a free browser extension, so it runs on most devices with a common browser.

**For the technically curious:** Blobbs are built on Active Inference and Promise Theory. They learn on their own by constantly refining their expectations about the world.

[https://aic-ai-lab.site/blobb/en](https://aic-ai-lab.site/blobb/en)
